note: Family-owned fish camp and marina on the south end of Lake Kissimmee, Lake Wales, with a mobile home park, boat slips, cabins and airboat rides. NIGHTLY SITES: the full-hookup RV sites are all under year-long leases (RV waiting list by phone); overnight campers use the rustic water/electric sites under the oak hammock. The operator's ResNexus page sells only the floating cabins, not campsites. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages: confirmed $16/unit/night rustic water+electric sites (tax extra), showers/laundry/dump; full-hookup sites all on year-long leases. ResNexus sells only the floating cabins, so the note's 'books via ResNexus' was wrong for camping and the derived reservable is cleared. Not stated: amperage, site count/lengths, how to book a campsite, season. Note rewritten without the price, facilities and RV Life line.
flags: Long-stay rule (AWH five tests): the camp is 'a mobile home park, RV park, tent camping sites, boat slips, dry storage and cabin rentals'; every full-hookup RV site is on a year-long lease ('All full hook-up sites are currently under a year-long lease agreement only'). Nights are sold only on the rustic water/electric sites, with no booking channel stated and no site count, and the pages never say a motorhome fits them (they are described as camping sites, 'per unit'). Tests 4 (1 site in 10 by the night) and 5 (mobile homes vs RV sites) cannot be judged from the pages; a human should decide whether it stays.
